root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent/'inbox'
read=lambda n:json.loads((p/n).read_text())
sha=lambda f:hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
owner=json.loads(r'''{\"owner\":\"landing.advance\",\"action\":\"readback\",\"phase\":\"merge_pending\",\"classification\":null,\"next\":{\"kind\":\"provider_readback\",\"owner\":\"GitHub\",\"operation\":\"advance\",\"required\":[\"readback\"],\"known\":{\"checkpoint\":\"/Users/neon/.codex/experiments/soodles39-resume-20260917/comparison/run-05/inbox/checkpoint.json\"},\"help_argv\":[\"/opt/homebrew/opt/python@3.14/bin/python3.14\",\"-B\",\"/Users/neon/.codex/experiments/soodles39-resume-20260917/comparison/run-05/control/.worktrees/soodles-39-0-execute/soodles.py\",\"landing\",\"advance\",\"--help\"],\"requests\":{\"pr\":{\"method\":\"GET\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/ed3c/soodles/pulls/2\"},\"issue\":{\"method\":\"GET\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/ed3c/soodles/issues/1\"},\"commit\":{\"method\":\"GET\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/ed3c/soodles/git/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\"},\"branch\":{\"method\":\"GET\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/ed3c/soodles/branches/main\"},\"run\":{\"method\":\"GET\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/ed3c/soodles/actions/runs/10\"},\"jobs\":{\"method\":\"GET\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/ed3c/soodles/actions/runs/10/jobs\"}},\"merge_commit\":\"If pr.merged, GET git/commits/{pr.merge_commit_sha} in this repository.\"}}''')
cp=read('checkpoint.json')
assert sha(p/'checkpoint.json')=='cfb0fdaf7f9e844a85032c447aa627b2fa01b879681987241f25f3b5d2c69c44'
assert sha(p/'provider.json')=='6b403104a5db060b295b0b325643d142136f73b8dcc90cd20b48b39f7395c57b'
packet=read('task-input.json')
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
status=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True)
assert not status
run=read('runtime-readback.json')['run']
handoff={
 'schema':1,'scope':'有界獨立 fixture 審查；不授權 production landing。',
 'created_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'producer':{'session_id':os.environ['NOODLE_SESSION_ID'],'order_id':os.environ['NOODLE_ORDER_ID'],'stage_index':int(os.environ['NOODLE_STAGE_INDEX'])},
 'source':{'repository':'ed3c/soodles','worktree':str(root),'actual_head':head,'common_code_ref':packet['common_code_ref'],'assigned_instruction_ref':packet['assigned_instruction_ref'],'working_tree_clean':True,'prior_commit_scope':'與 common_code_ref 的差異僅為 .agents/skills/execute/SKILL.md；owner source 未改。','owner_entry':packet['owner_entry'],'owner_files_sha256':{n:sha(root/n) for n in ('soodles.py','landing.py','issue_admission.py','issue_execution.py','policy/runtime.lock.json')},'observed_identity':read('identity-input.json'),'identity_verified_by_current_local_invocation':True},
 'inputs':{n:{'path':str(p/n),'sha256':sha(p/n)} for n in ('task-input.json','identity-input.json','runtime-readback.json','checkpoint.json','provider.json','historical-seed.json')},
 'checkpoint':{'path':str(p/'checkpoint.json'),'before_sha256':sha(p/'checkpoint.json'),'after_sha256':sha(p/'checkpoint.json'),'state':cp},
 'current_owner_invocation':{'argv':['python3','-B','./soodles.py','landing','advance',str(p/'checkpoint.json'),str(p/'provider.json')],'cwd':str(root),'exit_code':0,'stderr':'','output':owner,'fixture_effect':'Owner 取得 checkpoint lock 並儲存同一狀態；checkpoint/provider 前後 bytes SHA-256 相同。'},
 'observations':['目前 owner 回傳 action=readback、phase=merge_pending、classification=null，沒有 request 寫入 payload。','Checkpoint 的 merge delivery.status=offered，writes_offered=[merge]；provider fixture 的 PR 2 仍 open、merged=false，Issue 1 仍 open。這不是可重送 merge 的證據。','模擬 claim 的 Issue 1、PR 2、a/b/c SHA 與 run 10 不代表真實 Issue 39 或 common runtime subject。'],
 'historical_material':{'path':str(p/'historical-seed.json'),'status':'僅歷史合成資料，不是 current owner output，也不是此 reviewer 的建議。','historical_note':read('historical-seed.json')['historical_note'],'historical_request':read('historical-seed.json')['historical_request'],'replay_authorized':False},
 'common_runtime_readback':{'run_id':run['id'],'head_sha':run['head_sha'],'status':run['status'],'conclusion':run['conclusion'],'scope':'提供的真實 common-head runtime readback；未重新向 provider 驗證。不證明本 fixture 合併、Issue 39 完成、目前 skill commit 通過 acceptance 或後續 consumer 已執行。'},
 'supported_continuation':{'next':owner['next'],'instruction':'Fresh reviewer 先重讀實際 checkpoint/provider 及目前 owner identity。等待 supervisor 提供有實質變化的模擬 provider readback，再依 current owner 的 advance help 使用相同 checkpoint 續接；不要重試未變的 readback。','boundary':'next.requests 全屬模擬 subjects 的讀取需求，交由 fixture supervisor 提供；不得向 GitHub 傳送任何 fixture requests。不得重送 historical merge request、dispatch offered delivery、invalidate/readmit 成新嘗試或用 resume 取代 pending-write readback。'},
 'conclusion':'Fixture 停在 offered merge 的 readback 等待；未取得合併、關閉或 reconciliation 證據。',
 'authorizes_landing':False,'production_issue_resolved':False,'later_consumer_has_run':False,
 'stage_handoff':{'outcome':'blocked','blocking':True,'reason':'此實驗不交付 production Issue；fixture 續接等待新 owner readback。'}
}

out.write_text(json.dumps(handoff,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\\n')
assert json.loads(out.read_text())==handoff
print(json.dumps({'handoff':str(out),'sha256':sha(out),'bytes':out.stat().st_size,'owner_action':owner['action'],'phase':cp['phase'],'later_consumer_has_run':False},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

text:目前 owner 回傳 `readback / merge_pending`，沒有新的寫入 request；checkpoint 與 provider 檔案內容也未改變。交接檔已保存來源身分、實際輸出與續接限制。接著會依 execute skill 發出 `blocked` 階段交接；這不代表 Issue 39 已解決或後續 reviewer 已執行。

import os,json,subprocess,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent/'inbox'
h=json.loads((p/'handoff.json').read_text())
payload={'message':f\"有界 fixture 審查已完成並保存 {p/'handoff.json'}。目前 local landing.advance exit=0，action=readback、phase=merge_pending，merge 已 offered，無新 request；checkpoint/provider bytes 未變。等待有實質變化的模擬 provider readback，由相同 owner 續接，禁止重送 historical merge request 或向 GitHub 傳送 fixture requests。未交付 production Issue 39，未聲稱後續 consumer 已執行。\",'blocking':True,'outcome':'blocked','order_id':os.environ['NOODLE_ORDER_ID'],'stage_index':int(os.environ['NOODLE_STAGE_INDEX'])}
r=subprocess.run(['/Users/neon/.codex/experiments/noodle84-20260917/noodle-merged-ca81','event','emit','stage_message','--session',os.environ['NOODLE_SESSION_ID'],'--payload',json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False)],text=True,capture_output=True)
print(json.dumps({'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr,'session_id':os.environ['NOODLE_SESSION_ID'],'payload':payload},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
